title: randia mollis
intro: Randia mollis, commonly known as the velvet tree or velvet randia, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, diarrhea, and respiratory infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Randia mollis include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. Studies have identified these compounds as responsible for its medicinal properties, including its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities.
